capabilities: Parse a natural-language task line into title, tags, due/scheduled dates, time estimate, and recurrence
Recognize user-defined custom properties inline by name, value, or regex
Apply markdown templates and merge their frontmatter into the new task file
Highlight recognized dates, recurrence, statuses, and properties while typing
Open a file picker to insert [[links]] from a typed character
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; code is MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: Core QuickAdd-style functionality in this plugin was extracted and adapted from tasknotes.
problem: Creating a task note in Obsidian means manually writing frontmatter and filling in dates, tags, and properties field by field for every task.

summary: Natural-language task creator that parses dates, recurrence, and custom properties from one line into structured task notes with templated frontmatter.
